label: Post-COVID neuropsychiatric symptoms in India: Prevalence, risk factors, and persistence.
summary: The global research has actively investigated the post-COVID neuropsychiatric symptoms (PCNS). There is a paucity of studies from India that explore long-term PCNS. This study aims to estimate prevalence, types of PCNS, associated factors (sociodemographic factors, life events, COVID-19-related variables, and vaccination status) and persistence of PCNS after two years.
